_doc: Labeled trigger set for skill descriptions (round-2 research R2-7; Anthropic/agentskills.io guidance: verify descriptions with should- and should-not-trigger queries including near-misses). The deterministic test only checks shape and coverage. A live run (host-specific, opt-in, never in run_all.sh) would send each query to an agent with the suite installed and compare the skill it loads against `expect`. Queries are synthetic placeholders. Replace them with the DS team's real phrasings when available. `expect` is a sub-skill name or `none` (the suite should not trigger).
